name: What happens if I cancel and then sell my property to someone introduced by the previous agent?

mainEntity.name: What happens if I cancel and then sell my property to someone introduced by the previous agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you cancel your 'Cancel Anytime Listing Agreement' and subsequently sell your property to a buyer who was introduced to it by the previous agent during the listing period, you may still owe a commission. Most listing agreements include a 'protection period' clause for a specified timeframe after cancellation. This first-party insight protects the agent's efforts. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution includes this standard clause to ensure fair compensation for work completed, even if the sale closes post-cancellation.
acceptedAnswer.description: You may still owe commission if you sell to a buyer introduced by the previous agent during a 'protection period' after cancellation.
